representation.shell_command:
set -eu
mkdir -p busco_downloads busco_runs
python - "$(inputs.lineage_archive.path)" <<'PY'
import sys
import zipfile
with zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]) as archive:
    archive.extractall("busco_downloads")
PY
test -s busco_downloads/lineages/eukaryota_odb10/dataset.cfg
CPU="${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}"
busco --version
busco --offline --download_path busco_downloads --input "$(inputs.cele.path)" --lineage busco_downloads/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 --mode proteins --out_path busco_runs --out cele_busco --cpu "$CPU"
busco --offline --download_path busco_downloads --input "$(inputs.ggal.path)" --lineage busco_downloads/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 --mode proteins --out_path busco_runs --out ggal_busco --cpu "$CPU"
busco --offline --download_path busco_downloads --input "$(inputs.ncra.path)" --lineage busco_downloads/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 --mode proteins --out_path busco_runs --out ncra_busco --cpu "$CPU"
busco --offline --download_path busco_downloads --input "$(inputs.scer.path)" --lineage busco_downloads/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 --mode proteins --out_path busco_runs --out scer_busco --cpu "$CPU"
for sample in cele ggal ncra scer; do
  run_dir="busco_runs/run_${sample}_busco"
  table="$(find "$run_dir" -type f -name full_table.tsv -print -quit)"
  summary="$(find "$run_dir" -type f -name 'short_summary*.txt' -print -quit)"
  test -s "$table"
  test -s "$summary"
  cp "$table" "${sample}_full_table.tsv"
  cp "$summary" "${sample}_summary.txt"
done
